correctness.rationale: For fixed integer M>=1 and a,b>0, the initial M-window has the stationary beta-binomial exchangeable distribution; the finite binary shift chain is irreducible, aperiodic, and exponentially mixing. Its binary covariance equals v at lag 0, v/(kappa+1) for 1..M, and thereafter satisfies the finite-memory linear recurrence with denominator M+kappa. Absolute summability permits summing the recurrence to integrated variance v*(M+kappa)*(M+kappa+1)/(kappa*(kappa+1)). The functional Markov CLT plus summation by parts yields the n^(-3/2) weighted edge-count CLT with variance one-third this value; dominated covariance summation establishes the separate n^(-3) variance limit. The fixed-M ergodic n^(-2) limit rho/2 differs from Beta-random infinite-memory limit Theta/2. Checked the conditional law, lag normalization, variance weights, terminal universal-vertex O(n) perturbation, and distinction between fixed and growing M. Independent exact SymPy finite-state Poisson checks for M=1..4 and (a,b)=(1,1),(2,3) corroborated the integrated factor, not the infinite CLT.
